articles.title: One in a Million review – deeply moving film about displacement, freedom and the upheaval of starting again
articles.summary:
Following a Syrian mother and daughter over a decade, Itab Azzam and Jack MacInnes capture a family transformed

There’s a startling moment in this BBC refugee documentary when Syrian mother Nisreen – in the apparently miserable situation of hiking across the Balkans towards Germany, four kids in tow – suddenly explodes with joy. “This is the best holiday I’ve ever had! It’s an amazing adventure. Now I have the chance to walk in the rain – I love it!” Shunted off early into an arranged marriage, never having left Syria until forced out of Aleppo by the civil war, for Nisreen this running jump into the unknown represents total liberation.

Itab Azzam and Jack MacInnes’ superb, forthright and highly moving film bypasses the usual refugee dichotomies, that they’re either external threats or history’s victims. Instead of flat abstractions, we get the knotty reality. Focused over a 10-year period from 2015 to 2025 principally on Nisreen’s eldest daughter Israa, it presents an intimate chronicle of how geographical displacement and cultural dislocation reshape families and lives from the inside.

Supermarket chains in Sweden, Belgium and Luxembourg have said the temperatures of their refrigerators and freezers in dozens of stores rose overnight, prompting fears of a cyber-attack similar to one that caused millions of euros of food losses in France.

Sweden’s Coop chain told the daily Aftonbladet on Monday that six of ​its stores ‌had been ​affected, while ICA said it was “aware that a limited ​number of stores were affected by an incident overnight which impacted their refrigeration and freezer systems”.

articles.title: Hackers send fake nuclear threat alert to Ukraine emergency app
articles.summary:
Residents in Kyiv also warned of chemical attack and street-to-street fighting in false message sent by unknown party

  • Europe live – latest updates

Unknown hackers have targeted Ukraine’s nationwide emergency alert mobile app, sending residents in Kyiv a warning that they were at risk of an imminent nuclear strike.

The app reported a high possibility of nuclear radiation late on Sunday. It also wrongly warned of a chemical threat to the Ukrainian capital and street-to-street fighting. The messages were written in English with spelling mistakes, as well as in Ukrainian.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vlně sociálních nepokojů a protestů mladé generace v Německu a Francii spojených s životními náklady, zatímco geopolitické napětí roste kvůli útokům v Černém moři a eskalaci na Blízkém východě. Současně se prohlubují vnitropolitické spory v Polsku ohledně ústavního soudu a nejistota kolem německých zásob plynu.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of social unrest and youth-led protests in Germany and France over living costs, while geopolitical tensions rise due to Black Sea attacks and Middle Eastern escalations. At the same time, domestic political disputes in Poland regarding the Constitutional Tribunal and uncertainties over German gas storage are deepening.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající tlak na veřejný pořádek v západní Evropě a zvýšenou volatilitu na trzích s plynem kvůli stavu německých zásob.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent pressure on public order in Western Europe and increased volatility in gas markets due to German storage levels are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci rozsáhlých občanských nepokojů a protestů proti životním nákladům v Německu a Francii, rostoucímu napětí na Ukrajině po skončení příměří a politické nestabilitě po pádu vlád v jihovýchodní Evropě. Zároveň se prohlubují institucionální výzvy v EU, včetně debat o užším propojení s Kanadou a tlaku průmyslu na deregulaci.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces a combination of widespread civil unrest and cost-of-living protests in Germany and France, escalating tensions in Ukraine following the expiration of the truce, and political instability following shifts in Southeastern Europe. Simultaneously, EU institutional challenges are deepening, including debates over closer ties with Canada and industrial pressure for deregulation.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat eskalaci bezpečnostních opatření v reakci na rozsáhlé protesty v Německu a Francii a pokračující volatilitu na energetických trzích.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, an escalation of security measures in response to widespread protests in Germany and France, alongside continued volatility in energy markets, can be expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vlně sociálních nepokojů a kybernetických útoků cílících na kritickou infrastrukturu, včetně supermarketů v několika zemích. Politická nestabilita se projevuje vládními krizemi v Belgii a masovými protesty v Německu a Francii, zatímco geopolitická napětí zůstávají vysoká kvůli válce na Ukrajině.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of social unrest and cyberattacks targeting critical infrastructure, including supermarkets across multiple countries. Political instability is evident through government crises in Belgium and mass protests in Germany and France, while geopolitical tensions remain high due to the war in Ukraine.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující bezpečnostní dohled nad kritickou infrastrukturou v reakci na vlnu kybernetických útoků a napjatou politickou situaci v členských státech.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued security oversight of critical infrastructure can be expected in response to the wave of cyberattacks and tense political situations in member states.
